captions.detailed: A security road wedge barrier designed to be flush with the ground. It features a dark grey or black rectangular steel housing frame with a central, golden-yellow rectangular wedge plate. The wedge plate is designed to tilt upward from its rear edge via a revolute hinge, rotating about a horizontal axis to block oncoming vehicles.
captions.instruction: Generate a security road wedge barrier with a dark grey rectangular steel housing frame and a golden-yellow rectangular wedge plate that tilts upward on a revolute hinge along its rear edge.
captions.factory: Create a base housing assembly using box primitives to represent the outer frame and subterranean enclosure. Model the movable wedge plate as a separate rectangular box primitive. Define a revolute articulation joint located at the rear edge of the wedge plate, rotating around a horizontal axis (Y-axis) to allow the plate to swing upward.
